    def _date_summary():

        if preset in ("1y", "3y", "all"):

        if _filters["date_from"] or _filters["date_to"]:
            return f"{_filters['date_from'] or '…'}〜{_filters['date_to'] or '…'}"
        return "指定なし"

    def _sync_date_preset_buttons():
        for key, btn in _date_preset_buttons.items():
            active = key == _filters["date_preset"]
            btn.style = ft.ButtonStyle(
                color=ft.Colors.PRIMARY if active else ft.Colors.ON_SURFACE,
                bgcolor=ft.Colors.with_opacity(0.12, ft.Colors.PRIMARY) if active else ft.Colors.TRANSPARENT,
            )
            with _ui_update_lock:
                try:
                    btn.update()
                except Exception:
                    pass

    def _on_date_change(_e=None):
        _filters["date_from"] = date_from_field.value or ""
        _filters["date_to"] = date_to_field.value or ""
        _filters["date_preset"] = "custom"
        _sync_date_preset_buttons()
        fp.refresh()
        _refresh_after_filter_change()
    date_from_field.on_change = _on_date_change
    date_to_field.on_change = _on_date_change

    def _apply_date_preset(preset):
        _filters["date_preset"] = preset
        today = datetime.now().date()
        if preset == "1y":
            _filters["date_from"] = today.replace(year=today.year - 1).isoformat()
            _filters["date_to"] = ""
        elif preset == "3y":
            _filters["date_from"] = today.replace(year=today.year - 3).isoformat()
            _filters["date_to"] = ""
        elif preset == "all":
            _filters["date_from"] = ""
            _filters["date_to"] = ""

        date_to_field.value = _filters["date_to"]

        _refresh_after_filter_change()

        _date_preset_buttons[_preset_key] = _btn
        date_preset_row_controls.append(_btn)
    date_preset_row = ft.Row(date_preset_row_controls, spacing=2, wrap=True)
